clips.name: idle-stand
clips.prompt: {appearance} A locked side-view camera. The cat stands calmly against a perfectly flat teal background. Only subtle breathing and one natural blink. No camera movement, no cuts, no props. Quiet room tone.

clips.name: stand-to-sit
clips.prompt: {appearance} A locked side-view camera. The cat lowers its hindquarters into a calm sit over two seconds. The near rear toe stays planted; the front paws take natural small steps. No camera movement, no cuts, no props. Quiet room tone.
